scope: Primary author/publication sources; no copied implementation or unverified benchmark superiority claim

sources.title: Anomaly Detection in the Open World: Normality Shift Detection, Explanation, and Adaptation
sources.finding: OWAD already studies normality shift, output calibration, distribution-level detection and adaptation with reduced manual labeling.
sources.relevance: Adding retraining alone is not a new research claim. Our frozen experiment is a FedMSE-specific controlled ablation with a verifier assumption; OWAD was inspected, not reproduced as a benchmark.

sources.title: When Model Meets New Normals: Test-time Adaptation for Unsupervised Time-series Anomaly Detection
sources.finding: Prior work studies changing normal patterns and test-time adaptation for unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors.
sources.relevance: Supports motivation, not a proof that our method improves. Our CSV row-block scenarios do not reproduce temporal sequence evaluation from that work.

sources.title: Unsupervised Model Selection for Time-series Anomaly Detection
sources.finding: Prediction error, model centrality and injected synthetic-anomaly performance are imperfect surrogate metrics; the paper combines rankings.
sources.relevance: Normal reconstruction MSE alone is an exploratory control, not a reliable guarantee of attack detection. A future stronger label-scarcity study should compare rank-aggregated or synthetic-validation selectors on untouched data.
